changes.problem: Current conditions lost when asking for a study
changes.rootCause: A whole-message source-word veto mistook discovery intent for source attribution.
changes.fix: Recognize attributed sentences, preserving current measurements elsewhere; retain quote, hypothetical and range guards.

changes.problem: Wrong physical quantity or material identity
changes.rootCause: Gas percentages and specimen temperatures could collide with oxygen and ambient inputs; fuel vocabulary was incomplete and mixtures could lose their qualifier.
changes.fix: Bind gas percentage and thickness to their local labels; exclude explicit nonambient temperatures; retain explicit composition and add named fuel aliases.

changes.problem: Stale values after an explicit unknown
changes.rootCause: An explicit unknown was treated like an absent field, preserving an old measurement.
changes.fix: Clear that explicitly named current field and its basis; keep other fields unchanged.

changes.problem: Different materials assembled into one numerical score
changes.rootCause: With no user material, independent best values could come from different source materials.
changes.fix: Select one identified source material family for parameter-wise comparison; show it; do not credit unidentified families. Align diagnostics to awarded references.

changes.problem: Reused row identifiers implied a jointly tested tuple
changes.rootCause: The joint-reference check used runId without source file identity.
changes.fix: Require matching file identity, hash and runId, plus existing joint flags. Separate fragments remain separate.

changes.problem: Partial evidence displayed as a headline 100 percent
changes.rootCause: The card emphasized supported-input proximity instead of ranked points, hiding incomplete coverage.
changes.fix: Display total earned points and assessed denominator first, supported-input count and conditional proximity second. Clarify Data / conditions reference wording.

changes.problem: Close measured studies could miss the candidate shortlist
changes.rootCause: Material candidates were ordered primarily by text overlap rather than indexed numerical evidence.
changes.fix: Rank same-material candidates by parameter support before lexical tie breakers; retain content-retrieval slots and related-composite review.

severityBasis: High: incorrect scientific-input/selection semantics. Medium: misleading score presentation. No operational hazard classification or certification is asserted.
